_comment: Illustrative Claude Code hooks for the Card-Krueger DiD project. Copy to .claude/settings.json only when you want these hooks. In an interactive session, the workspace trust dialog is what allows settings-file hooks to run. /hooks lists loaded hooks and their commands; it does not approve them. The Stop hook appends a line to notes/orchestration_log.md.

hooks.command: echo '[Hook] Claude Code session stopped. Review diff before merging.' >> notes/orchestration_log.md
